content: {"paper_id":"W2965190526","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"Partial label learning deals with training examples each associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one label is valid.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确研究对象是偏标记学习：每个训练示例给出候选标签集合且仅一个标签有效，符合该研究设定。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"We call this kind of problem semi-supervised partial label learning.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文将问题称为半监督偏标记学习，并利用大量未标注实例与部分标注示例共同学习，符合有限监督加未标注样本的半监督设定。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Partial label learning deals with training examples each associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one label is valid.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"候选标签集合只含一个有效标签，属于不精确/不完整的监督信号，论文以此弱监督条件为实质研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"an iterative label propagation procedure between partial label examples and unlabeled instances is employed to disambiguate the candidate label sets of partial label examples as well as assign valid labels to unlabeled instances","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"迭代标签传播为未标注实例分配有效标签，并利用这些标签在后续迭代中消歧候选标签，构成迭代自训练/伪标签信号。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
